title_sq: Shitet super apartament 1+1 te rezidenca Nokia!
description_sq:
Apartament 1+1, 52,2 m2, kati 4, orientim lindje te rezidenca Nokia
Mundesi rezervimi me 1.000 Euro!
Pagese 20% realizohet me fillimin e punimeve dhe 80% ne momentin qe apartamenti eshte i perfunduar totalisht me dyer, dritare, grila, laminat AC5 dhe tualet i kompletuar me hidrosanitare inkaso.
Mundesi kreditimi 80% me kolateralin e kompanise. Nokia eshte e vendosur në periferi të Tiranës, pranë Liqenit të Farkës dhe zhvillimit ekzistues Mangalem 21, godina ngrihet në një terren shumë të pjerrët me pamje te lire te papenguar.
title_en: Super apartment 1+1 in Nokia residence for sale!
description_en: Apartment 1+1, 52.2 m2, 4th floor, east orientation of the Nokia residence. Possibility of reservation for 1,000 Euro! Payment of 20% is made at the beginning of the works and 80% when the apartment is completely finished with doors, windows, shutters, AC5 laminate and a toilet complete with inkaso hydro-sanitary. Possibility of 80% credit with the company's collateral. Nokia is located on the outskirts of Tirana, near Farka Lake and the existing Mangalem 21 development, the building rises on a very steep terrain with a clear unobstructed view.
